user_query: I'm a travel photographer and I'm looking for unique locations to capture breathtaking shots. Can you recommend some webcams in remote and lesser-known places? Additionally, I'd like to explore the postal unit boundaries in the United Kingdom to compare them with other countries.

TaskList.description: Search for unique webcams located in remote and lesser-known places.
Collect data on the postal unit boundaries in the United Kingdom.
Gather postal unit boundary data from other countries for comparison.
Analyze and compare the postal unit boundaries in the UK with those from other selected countries.
